rounds.text: Simca Advertising Ltd is profoundly under-appreciated, trading at a modest P/E of 15.6x [E1] while delivering extraordinary capital efficiency that completely dwarfs its sector benchmarks [E8, E9]. The company boasts a phenomenal ROE of 57.24% against a sector average of 16.83% [E8], alongside an eye-watering ROCE of 78.29% compared to the sector's 20.25% [E9], with multi-year medians sustaining these elite levels above 80% [E17, E37]. This operational excellence translates directly into aggressive, compounding expansion, highlighted by a 3-year compounded sales and profit growth of 120% each, paired with trailing twelve-month sales and profit surges of 70% and 67% respectively [E13, E14, E15, E16]. Furthermore, the business is pristine financially, carrying absolute zero debt at 0.00x debt-to-equity [E26] and generating real financial muscle with Rs 11 Cr in operating cash flow and Rs 6 Cr in free cash flow [E23, E24]. A discounted cash flow model explicitly quantifies this mispricing, revealing a massive 62.6% margin of safety where today's market price implies a meager 4.5% growth rate against an 18.0% base case assumption [E30, E31, E32]. Conceded: the dividend yield sits at 0.00% and the operating-margin trend is flagged as inconsistent over the short term [E3, E20, E21].
